findings.claim: DeleteInvoice deletes whatever invoice the id names without checking that it belongs to the caller, where GetInvoice checks inv.OwnerID != user.ID: any signed-in user can delete anyone's invoice.
findings.suggested_fix: Load the user with auth.UserFrom(r.Context()) and answer NotFound when inv.OwnerID != user.ID, as GetInvoice does, before deleting.
